articles.title: LB Greenlaw returns to 49ers as DE Huff retires
articles.summary: Linebacker Dre Greenlaw is returning to the 49ers, agreeing to terms on a one-year, $7.5 million contract, a source told ESPN. Defensive end Bryce Huff, however, is retiring from the NFL, he announced.

articles.title: Sources: Bengals add Allen in latest boost to D
articles.summary: Defensive tackle Jonathan Allen and the Bengals have agreed to a two-year, $28 million contract, sources told ESPN's Jeremy Fowler on Thursday.

articles.title: Commanders add RB White to bolster backfield
articles.summary: The Commanders have agreed to terms with free agent running back Rachaad White, agent Sunny Shah told ESPN's Adam Schefter on Thursday.

articles.title: Jags' GM: Thomas trade rumors 'fraudulent claims'
articles.summary: Jaguars general manager James Gladstone said the team is not trying to trade receiver Brian Thomas Jr. and called any reports that they were shopping the third-year player "fraudulent claims."

articles.title: Source: Dolphins sign WR Atwell to 1-year deal
articles.summary: The Dolphins are signing free agent wide receiver Tutu Atwell to a one-year deal, a source told ESPN's Adam Schefter on Thursday.

articles.title: Evans: Niners were one piece away; I'm that guy
